content.title: About
content.content: An egg sandwich on a griddle or pancake is a quick, hearty breakfast consisting of eggs, toasted bread or a pancake base, often topped with cheese, ham, vegetables, and sauces. Griddle cooking gives a light crisp, while a pancake makes it soft and tender.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The first recorded egg sandwich dates back to the early 20th century when eggs became a staple in diners.
Griddle sandwiches are often made on a flat-top grill, allowing fast cooking without added oil.
Using a pancake as the “bread” became popular in the US during the 1970s as a lower‑carb alternative.
Variations with avocado, spinach, or hummus gained popularity during the health‑food movement.
Griddle sandwiches are commonly served with hash browns or a fresh side salad.

items.title: High in protein
items.content: Eggs provide a complete source of protein essential for muscle growth and repair.

items.title: B‑vitamin source
items.content: The yolk contains B12, B2, and folate, supporting energy metabolism.

items.title: Contains healthy fats
items.content: Adding avocado or cheese supplies monounsaturated fats beneficial for heart health.

items.title: Promotes satiety
items.content: The combination of protein and complex carbs (bread or pancake) helps keep you full longer.

items.title: Vitamin D and calcium
items.content: Cheese adds calcium and vitamin D, supporting bone health.

items.title: Egg allergy
items.content: Some individuals may experience allergic reactions to egg whites.

items.title: Cholesterol content
items.content: Egg yolks contain cholesterol; those with high cholesterol should consume in moderation.

items.title: Sodium levels
items.content: Prepared sauces or processed meats can raise the sodium content.

items.title: Foodborne illness risk
items.content: Undercooked eggs may harbor salmonella; cook until fully set.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Enjoy the sandwich hot, cut in half if desired. It pairs well with sliced veggies, fresh salad, ranch dressing, or mustard. For a lighter version, use whole‑grain bread or a gluten‑free pancake.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Best eaten immediately. If needed, store in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 24 hours. Reheat on a griddle or in the microwave before serving.
